title: 第540章 让小灰灰心脏复原的方法
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始

第(1/3)页

【羊村村民规则八】：所有羊优先服从慢羊羊的指令，在羊村其余羊未死之前，慢羊羊不能发生死亡。

喜羊羊支开他的原因，清晰可闻。

他之所以没有追问喜羊羊为何会有懒羊羊的薯片，就是觉得事情有些蹊跷。

毕竟那包薯片是懒羊羊最在意的东西，怎么可能会就这么白给喜羊羊？

之前是因为林远真的杀死了喜羊羊和美羊羊，为了让他们活着，懒羊羊才喂给它们薯片的。

现在计划里出现了薯片，却没有出现薯片的拥有者懒羊羊。

并且懒羊羊既然让灰羊和黑羊变成了薯片，那喜羊羊又是从何处知道，白羊没有死的？

除非......它见过白羊吃下了薯片。

喜羊羊脸部微微抽搐，眼光烁动。

“灰太狼，我没想到......不过你帮我，我就告诉你复活小灰灰的办法。”

林远摇了摇头：

“风险太大，我要是没做好，只会加剧红红和小灰灰的死亡。”

虽然林远知道，它们在灰太狼死后会传送走，但此刻必须这么说。

喜羊羊有些着急，它的声音也有些急促：

“灰太狼，懒羊羊的薯片现在在我手里，袋子里一共一千多块薯片，足够羊村的羊复活了。”

“现在的村长不是真的，我要杀了他，为真的村长报仇。”

林远抚向额角，抬了抬眉：

“与本大王何干？”

“慢羊羊死就死了，我的小灰灰和老婆活着就好。”

喜羊羊脸色大变，观察出林远说的是真心话。

“如果你不帮我，我就在羊村外自尽！”

“反正懒羊羊的薯片我藏起来了，只要我把控好时间，你们三个......也得死。”

林远眼神有些轻蔑的看向喜羊羊：

“你这家伙，居然威胁我？”

不知道为什么，喜羊羊又再一次闻到了死亡的气味。

不过这是它最后的办法了。

“我没有办法，灰太狼。”

“如果村长死了，我想青青草原就会恢复正常吧......毕竟这么看来，村长就是始作俑者。”

喜羊羊吞了吞口水。

这确实是它这些日子分析出来的......从第一只羊死在村外开始，它就察觉了不对。

毕竟当时村长头上的藤蔓，只有一条。

并且当时的藤蔓上，还没有其余生物的头颅。

如果在那个时候他想办法弄死村长，现在的青青草原不可能是这样的。

羊村的所有羊体内都有一股不名状的黑气，每天聊天的时候大家都羊心惶惶。

它是真没有办法了......

等假的慢羊羊死后，它再用洞察力寻找真的村长。

就算村长死了，它也要找到尸体。

林远脸上浮现出了一抹讪笑：

“喜羊羊，拿出你的智谋来。”

[Yangcun Villager Rule 8]: All sheep give priority to obey the instructions of the slow sheep. The slow sheep cannot die before the other sheep in the Yangcun village die.

The reason why Pleasant Goat sent him away is clearly audible.

The reason why he didn't ask why Pleasant Goat had Lazy Goat's potato chips was that he felt something was a little strange.

After all, that bag of potato chips is what Lazy Goat cares about most. How could he just give it to Pleasant Goat for free?

Before, it was because Lin Yuan really killed Pleasant Goat and Beautiful Goat. In order to keep them alive, Lazy Goat fed them potato chips.

Now potato chips appear in the plan, but the owner of the potato chips, Lazy Yangyang, does not appear.

And since Lazy Goat turned the gray sheep and black sheep into potato chips, how did the Pleasant Goat know that the white sheep was not dead?

Unless...it's seen a white sheep eat potato chips.

Pleasant Goat's face twitched slightly and his eyes flickered.

"Big Big Wolf, I didn't expect...but if you help me, I will tell you how to resurrect little Huihui."

Lin Yuan shook his head:

"The risk is too high. If I don't do it well, it will only exacerbate the death of Hong Hong and Xiao Huihui."

Although Lin Yuan knew that they would teleport away after Big Wolf died, he had to say this at this moment.

Pleasant Goat was a little anxious, and its voice was also a little urgent:

"Big Big Wolf, Lazy Sheep's potato chips are in my hand now. There are more than a thousand potato chips in the bag, which is enough to revive the sheep in Yangcun."

"The current village chief is not real. I want to kill him and avenge the real village chief."

Lin Yuan touched his forehead and raised his eyebrows:

"What does it have to do with this king?"

"If the slow sheep dies, then it will be dead. My little Huihui and my wife will be fine as long as they are alive."

Pleasant Goat's face changed drastically, and he realized that Lin Yuan was telling the truth.

"If you don't help me, I will commit suicide outside Yangcun!"

"Anyway, I hid Lazy Yangyang's potato chips. As long as I control the time, you three... will also die."

Lin Yuan looked at Pleasant Goat with some contempt:

"You guy, you actually threaten me?"

I don’t know why, Pleasant Goat smelled the smell of death again.

But this is its last resort.

"I can't help it, Big Big Wolf."

"If the village chief dies, I think Qingqing Prairie will return to normal... After all, it seems that the village chief is the initiator."

Pleasant Goat swallowed.

This is indeed what it has analyzed these days... Ever since the first sheep died outside the village, it has sensed something was wrong.

After all, there was only one vine on the village chief's head at that time.

And there were no heads of other creatures on the vines at that time.

If he had tried to kill the village chief at that time, Qingqing Grassland would not be like this now.

All the sheep in Yangcun have an inexplicable black energy in their bodies, which makes everyone feel panicked when chatting every day.

There is really no other way...

After the fake slow sheep dies, it will use its insight to find the real village chief.

Even if the village chief dies, it still has to find the body.

A sneer appeared on Lin Yuan's face:

"Pleasant Goat, use your resourcefulness."
